Market today: The S&P 500 is in a correction, but bear markets don't always follow. Tech, especially AI and semiconductors, is getting a jolt from Nvidia news, which is the main driver for your concentrated book.

Your holdings: Most of your leveraged ETFs (PLTU, MSFU, MU, SOXL, SPAL) are deep in the red and marked SELL. QQQ and CRWD are also SELL. SMH is a SELL. SPY and METU are TRIM. Your stops are mostly far away, especially on the leveraged names, which is a concern given your margin.

Watch: Nvidia's performance today and the broader semiconductor ETF (SMH) action.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your deeply underwater, leveraged positions and respecting your stops.
plays: Consider trimming SPY if it breaks below 705.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
